FISHING LICENCE · PANAMA

Panama fishing licence

Panama's fisheries law requires an ARAP licence for sport fishing. A new personal-card system starts on December 10, 2026, after this record's check date.

Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Sport fishers fall under the licence requirement in article 66 of Law 204 of 2021.

Saltwater

The statutory requirement covers inland waters and marine waters under Panamanian jurisdiction.

Fishing with a guide or charter

Decree 9 provides a client exemption for authorized tourism fishing services from December 10, 2026. Confirm the present arrangement with ARAP.

Rules visitors should know

  • Carry the applicable ARAP authorization.
  • Do not apply the new December 2026 card rules to an earlier trip.

How to buy

Ask ARAP for the permit process that applies on your trip date.
